observation.visible_scene: A top-down view of a clear green pond with several koi fish, small dark fish, submerged plant stems, floating yellow and green leaves, and pink flowers. The fish swim slowly through the water while surface ripples and light patterns change.
visible_changes: The white-and-red koi across the upper area drift rightward relative to the fixed plants; the long white koi with red patches moves from near the center-right to farther right by the last frame.
The smaller red-and-white koi on the left also shifts rightward and changes tail angle.
The white/red/black koi at the bottom-left moves down-left toward the frame edge and becomes more cropped.
The dark blue/purple koi at the bottom-right change position and orientation, with one body moving toward the lower-right and partly out of view.
The pale cream/white koi near the center remains in roughly the same area but undulates, rotates slightly, and sweeps its tail.
The small multicolored koi right of center shifts position and orientation relative to nearby stems.
An orange/yellow fish-like shape appears at the left edge from around the middle of the clip and moves rightward into view.
Water ripples and bright surface patterns shift continuously, while the floating leaves, flowers, and plant stems stay in nearly fixed screen positions, indicating little or no camera movement.
outside_clip_unknowns: The full paths, origins, and destinations of the fish before and after this excerpt.
Whether the orange fish-like shape at the left edge fully enters the scene or moves back out.
Any external cause of the fish movement or water disturbance.
uncertain_details: Whether the orange shape at the left edge is a fish, a reflection, or another partially visible object.
Small apparent movements of some fish may be partly due to water refraction rather than actual translation.
Precise directions of slow-moving fish are difficult to determine from the overhead, distorted water view.
